Mississauga Data Centre Moratorium Faces Legal Challenges

Mississauga's one-year moratorium on data centre construction is facing a second legal challenge at the Ontario Land Tribunal, brought by a Toronto-based real estate investment firm. Separately, Calgary is set to hold public hearings regarding its own data centre moratorium.
